page.overview:
Who is Beachhead?

Beachhead has one goal: to do his best. That's what infuses everything he says and does. He focuses on the task he's been given and ignores anything that doesn't help him complete it. When things go bad, he channels his anger and frustration into fuel to help him go further and fight harder. He pushes himself to exceed his personal best and be an example to others, such as running ten miles every morning in blizzards, heat waves and anything in between.

He doesn't have any speaking lines but he's part of the H.A.A.R.P. team along with Roadblock, Gung-Ho and Stalker.
